description: This file is a script for auditing links in markdown documentation files within a project. It includes functions for walking directories, normalizing paths, resolving routes, and checking the validity of links and navigation entries in documentation. It also provides CLI commands to run link audits and handle anchor document directories.

methods.name: walk
methods.description: Recursively walks a directory to list all file paths excluding hidden files.

methods.name: normalizeSlashes
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes for consistent path representation.

methods.name: normalizeRoute
methods.description: Canonicalizes a route string by removing fragments, queries, and leading/trailing slashes.

methods.name: stripInlineCode
methods.description: Removes inline code snippets enclosed in backticks from a text.

methods.name: resolveRoute
methods.description: Resolves a route through potential redirects, detects loops, and checks if the route is published.

methods.name: collectNavPageEntries
methods.description: Recursively collects page entries from the navigation structure.

methods.name: sanitizeDocsConfigForEnglishOnly
methods.description: Sanitizes the documentation configuration to include only English and certain allowed structures.

methods.name: prepareAnchorAuditDocsDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory, copies docs, and sanitizes docs.json for anchor link auditing.

methods.name: auditDocsLinks
methods.description: Audits all links in markdown files for broken or invalid links, both internal and external.

methods.name: runDocsLinkAuditCli
methods.description: CLI command to perform the link audit, optionally checking anchors.
